parameters.name: Criteria
parameters.description:
The search conditions that are used to query assets. The value of this parameter is in the JSON format and is case-sensitive.

> A search condition can be an instance ID, instance name, virtual private cloud (VPC) ID, region, or public IP address. You can call the [DescribeCriteria](~~DescribeCriteria~~) operation to query the supported search conditions.

parameters.name: CriteriaOperation
parameters.description:
The type of the operation on search conditions. Valid values:

*   **add**: adds assets.
*   **del**: deletes assets.

parameters.name: SelectionKey
parameters.description: The unique ID of the asset.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas add-asset-selection-criteria --selection-key 5196d280-5bfa-496a-ba70-8a3935e30000 --criteria LogicalExp_:_AND_,_Criteria_:_name_:_osType_,_value_:_linux_,_logicalExp_:_AND_,_name_:_alarmStatus_,_value_:_YES_,_logicalExp_:_AND --criteria-operation add --target-operation-list Target=11880000 Operation=del --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
